images.title: Same end, same fraction
images.purpose: Show on a fraction wall that shaded runs of the same whole that end at the same place name equivalent fractions: 1/3 = 2/6 = 4/12.
images.composition: One fraction wall of four rows centred with white space around it, and one vertical line marking where the shaded runs end.
images.exact_structure: A fraction wall of 4 rows, each exactly the same length, left and right edges lined up, small gaps between rows. Row 1: 1 whole, plain. Row 2: 3 equal parts, the left 1 filled teal #0072B2. Row 3: 6 equal parts, the left 2 filled amber #E69F00. Row 4: 12 equal parts, the left 4 filled reddish purple #CC79A7. One grey #6B7280 vertical line drops from the end of the teal part through rows 3 and 4, touching the ends of the amber and purple runs. Fractions at the right of rows 2 to 4. Exactly 4 rows and 1 line.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any on-screen controls, panels or app frame drawn around the wall
images.takeaway: Runs that end at the same place on the wall are equivalent fractions.
images.description: A four row fraction wall: 1 whole, thirds, sixths and twelfths; 1/3, 2/6 and 4/12 are shaded and a vertical line shows they end at the same place.
images.context: Shown with the doer concept before the student practises. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to point at where the vertical line meets each shaded run and read out the three equal fractions.

image_decisions.why: The practice is about reading equal ends on a fraction wall; one clean wall picture sets up the idea.
